title: Map compact exact Run-004 mechanisms onto old and independent Second approach candidates
research_question: Which strongest numerical candidates are exactly closed by the compact fixed-support certificate library, how far are the remaining candidates from that exact frontier under S6 x S3, and which small survivor set should GPT-5.6 Sol study?
exact_coverage_rule: A candidate is covered only when a rational Run-004 certificate is re-verified exactly on that candidate support, possibly after an explicit S6 x S3 transformation.
hard_survivor_rule: Not covered by the tested compact certificate library and completed support-neighborhood searches. This is not a counterexample and not evidence that the full polynomial system is solvable.
scientific_output: Exact coverage tables split into old pool, legacy 2.0, and independent 2.0; symmetry-aware nearest mechanisms; one-edit and sampled two-edit frontier hits; and a compact hard-survivor handoff for GPT-5.6 Sol.
next_decision: Use the strongest separately reported hard survivors for targeted higher-degree exact tests and a compact GPT-5.6 Sol reasoning cycle.
